name: novelty_free
description: (c) Open-ended: 'free' actor-critic genomes whose structural plan constants (column seed counts, tissue size, band positions, wiring weights, memory on/off, 1 or 2 regions, tract density) are bounded evolvable genes. Selection = 0.5 x fitness + 0.5 x novelty of the behaviour (bandit best-arm rate, cue pass rate, log synapse count) against an archive.
